review.BT5-119#front#10: Official erratum replaces unsupported dynamic energy bound with <=3; Shenron price and own Drop Battle selector retained.

review.BT7-127#front#30: One-or-two Life choice becomes readable; the existing Broly Leader condition, optional Brolys Ring search/play/shuffle and if-you-do guard remain.
review.BT8-025#front#0: Bounded action price becomes executable; on-play power and delayed energy effect are unchanged. Regression scenario verifies one and two pay.
review.BT9-058#front#10: Bounded action price becomes executable; opponent-turn trigger/condition and green energy switch remain unchanged.
review.BT9-128#front#0: Bounded action price becomes executable; attack trigger, once-per-turn guard and source switch remain unchanged.
review.BT9-128#back#0: Same bounded price correction as front; awakened-face effect unchanged.
